summary: This is an XML document that describes a bookstore catalog containing four books. Each book entry includes metadata like title, author(s), publication year, price, and a category attribute. The document is structured hierarchically with a root bookstore element containing individual book elements.

explanations.1: This line declares that the file is XML format using version 1.0 and UTF-8 character encoding, which tells the parser how to read the document.
explanations.3: The category attribute on the book element is a way to tag or classify this book—in this case as 'cooking'—without creating a separate XML element for it.
explanations.4: The lang attribute on the title element specifies that the title text is written in English, allowing the document to potentially include titles in other languages elsewhere.
explanations.18: This book has multiple author elements instead of just one, which is valid XML because you can repeat the same element type multiple times to represent a list of values.
